display_name: 原 DURA 内部反向训练批量吞吐检查
description: 固定原 DURA，分别用 16 和 32 条源 IQ 各做三次临时完整梯度更新，不保存权重；测 GPU 吞吐与显存。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, batch16 and batch32

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: Four source RX4/6 view groups, 4 or 8 per group; 16/32 records

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Short transient source-only DURA gradient timing, not a model or identity evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Original source-only DURA stage2 E20/4940, copied into memory, no write to original
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Runtime verifies direct source-only checkpoint commit and permission fields, frozen_dura verifies DURA provenance
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both fixed Phase1 models, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA, no target score selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json GPU step times and peak allocated bytes at two batch sizes; no checkpoint

rows.method: Original DURA full physical and prior graph, three transient AdamW source IQ updates per batch size
rows.purpose: Measure cost before preregistering DURA internal refinement
rows.seed_notes: Original fixed DURA; no stochastic training or sampling; one fixed transient update.
rows.scenario: One each clean, high, mid and low suburban fixed source view, RX4/6
rows.budget_ref: 16 then 32 source pairs, each 3 optimizer steps, no saved model

notes: Same source batch repeated per measurement; exclude first step as warmup, loading and input preparation excluded.
No F/TX/V/target reads, no model saved, original DURA checkpoint unchanged.
Full new recovery versions require separate registration and seven-view test.
